text: なぜ　まけたのか　わかるか？

patterns.name: 〜のか
patterns.explanation: のか here wraps a question up inside a bigger sentence, so it can be the thing that is understood. なぜ　まけたのか = 'why you lost'.

patterns.name: 〜か
patterns.explanation: か at the end turns the line into a question; after a plain verb it sounds blunt. わかるか = 'do you understand?'.
